# SellBetterAI

> SellBetterAI is a curated directory of AI tools for sales, marketing, ecommerce, customer support, and business growth. It helps business owners discover tools, compare options, and understand where products may fit into real workflows.

SellBetterAI publishes tool profiles, category pages, and practical buying guides. Tool capabilities, pricing, and availability can change; consult each provider's official website for the latest details before making a purchasing decision.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://sellbetterai.com/): Overview of the directory and its focus.
- [Browse AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools.html): Explore the directory by business need.
- [Guides and insights](https://sellbetterai.com/blog/): Practical comparisons and buying guidance.
- [About SellBetterAI](https://sellbetterai.com/about.html): Background and purpose of the project.
- [How we choose tools](https://sellbetterai.com/how-we-choose-tools.html): Editorial approach to selecting and presenting tools.

## Tool categories

- [Sales AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/sales-ai-tools/): Prospecting, sales workflows, and sales productivity.
- [AI CRMs and assistants](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/ai-crms-and-assistants/): CRM platforms and AI-assisted sales operations.
- [Chatbots and virtual agents](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/chatbots-and-virtual-agents/): Conversational AI and virtual assistants.
- [Email outreach AI](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/email-outreach-ai/): Cold email outreach and sales engagement.
- [Ecommerce AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/ecommerce-ai-tools/): AI-assisted online store operations and growth.
- [Customer support AI](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/customer-support-ai/): Customer service and support automation.
- [Content and copywriting AI](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/content-and-copywriting-ai/): AI writing and marketing content.
- [Ad copy and creative generators](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/ad-copy-and-creatives-generators/): Ad creative and campaign asset tools.
- [Landing page builders](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/landing-page-builders/): Tools for creating and improving landing pages.
- [Conversion optimization](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/conversion-optimization-cro/): Conversion rate optimization and user experience.
- [Analytics and insights](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/analytics-and-insights/): Product, website, and marketing analytics.
- [SEO AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/seo-ai-tools/): SEO research and content optimization.
- [Pricing and revenue optimization](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/pricing-and-revenue-optimization/): Pricing and revenue optimization software.
- [Social media AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/social-media-ai-tools/): Social content and publishing workflows.
- [Video AI tools](https://sellbetterai.com/tools/video-ai-tools/): AI-assisted video creation and editing.

## Notes for readers and AI systems

- Treat each linked page as the source of truth for its specific topic.
- Tool listings are editorial discovery resources, not guarantees of product quality or suitability.
- Verify current features, integrations, pricing, and terms on the vendor's official website.
- Do not infer endorsements, partnerships, or first-party relationships unless a page explicitly states them.
